bullets.id: Emas menutup pekan di bawah $4.000: Trading Economics mencatat $3.993,96, turun 0,77% pada Jumat, hampir 4% sepekan dan 6,57% sebulan, level terendah sejak pertengahan Juli. Low intraday sekitar $3.975. Perak di sekitar $53,90, pertama kali di bawah $54 pada 2026. Pasar tutup akhir pekan, jadi harga ini menjadi titik awal pekan rapat Fed.
bullets.en: Gold ended the week below $4,000: Trading Economics shows $3,993.96, down 0.77% on Friday, almost 4% on the week and 6.57% on the month, its lowest since mid-July. The intraday low was about $3,975. Silver is near $53.90, below $54 for the first time in 2026. Markets are shut for the weekend, so this is the starting point for Fed week.

bullets.id: Tekanannya datang dari minyak dan suku bunga: Brent ditutup $116,72 (naik 3,14%), yield Treasury 10 tahun di sekitar 5,0% dan indeks dolar sekitar 101,8. CME FedWatch memberi peluang tahan suku bunga sekitar 90% untuk Rabu 28 Oktober (kisaran 3,75–4,00%), tetapi peluang kenaikan hingga Desember sekitar 80%. Emas sekitar 28,8% di bawah rekor $5.608,35 dari Januari.
bullets.en: The pressure comes from oil and rates: Brent settled at $116.72 (up 3.14%), the 10-year Treasury yield is near 5.0% and the dollar index about 101.8. CME FedWatch puts the odds of a hold on Wednesday, October 28 (3.75–4.00% range) at about 90%, but the odds of a hike by December at about 80%. Gold is about 28.8% below its $5,608.35 January record.

bullets.id: Agenda pekan ini: keputusan Fed dan konferensi pers Ketua Kevin Warsh Rabu 28 Oktober pukul 14.00 waktu AS, lalu PCE September dan PDB kuartal III pada Kamis 29 Oktober. Level dari Kitco: resistance $4.075; support $3.963 dan $3.946, dengan target turun $3.890. Skenario lunak (PCE dingin) membuka $4.150; skenario keras (sinyal kenaikan Desember) mengarah ke $3.890.
bullets.en: This week’s agenda: the Fed decision and Chair Kevin Warsh’s press conference on Wednesday, October 28 at 2 pm US time, then September PCE and third-quarter GDP on Thursday, October 29. Kitco’s levels: resistance at $4,075; support at $3,963 and $3,946, with a downside target of $3,890. A soft scenario (cool PCE) opens $4,150; a hawkish one (a December hike signal) points to $3,890.

bullets.id: Harga resmi Antam tidak diperbarui pada Minggu; data terakhir Rp2.540.000/gram dengan buyback Rp2.335.000 (spread sekitar 8,1%), pembaruan berikutnya Senin 08.30 WIB. Galeri24 turun Rp11.000 ke Rp2.467.000 (buyback Rp2.326.000, spread sekitar 5,7%) dan UBS turun Rp10.000 ke Rp2.491.000 (buyback Rp2.301.000, spread sekitar 7,6%). Bank sentral membeli 289 ton pada kuartal II, naik 62% secara tahunan.
bullets.en: Antam’s official price was not updated on Sunday; the latest is Rp2,540,000/gram with a Rp2,335,000 buyback (spread about 8.1%), with the next update Monday at 08:30 WIB. Galeri24 fell Rp11,000 to Rp2,467,000 (buyback Rp2,326,000, spread about 5.7%) and UBS fell Rp10,000 to Rp2,491,000 (buyback Rp2,301,000, spread about 7.6%). Central banks bought 289 tonnes in the second quarter, up 62% year on year.
